title: 194 Spartina Circle Vacation Rental
meta_description: 194 Spartina Circle is a 4.00 bedroom, 4.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description Welcome to 194 Spartina Circle, a stunning three-story retreat located in the heart of WaterColor’s Camp District. Just steps from Camp WaterColor, this inviting home offers spacious living areas, elegant coastal design, and thoughtful details that create the perfect setting for a relaxed family getaway.Property Highlights Exclusive Access to the WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pools with Up to 10 Passes Included 6-Passenger Electric Cart Included 6 Adult Bikes Included Parking for 2 Vehicles Outdoor Fireplace Propane Grill Steps From Camp WaterColor 7-Minute Electric Cart Ride to Seaside 6-Minute Electric Cart Ride to WaterColor Beach Club and Beach Access Experience the Home Nestled in the desirable Camp District, 194 Spartina Circle welcomes guests with its inviting blue exterior, screened porch, and charming bed swing, a perfect place to relax and watch the neighborhood come to life. Inside, an open-concept layout seamlessly connects the living room, kitchen, and dining area. The living space features comfortable seating, a gas fireplace, and plenty of natural light. The kitchen is equipped with high-end appliances, ample counter space, and everything needed to prepare family meals, while the formal dining area offers a lovely setting for shared gatherings. The first floor includes a comfortable guest bedroom overlooking the backyard and outdoor fireplace, along with a Murphy bedroom ideal for extra guests. A large laundry room and office nook provide convenience and flexibility for extended stays. Upstairs, the primary suite features a private screened porch, king bed, and a spacious bathroom with a soaking tub and walk-in shower. Two additional guest bedrooms on this floor include private or shared bathrooms, while a cozy bunk nook with twin bunks offers an ideal space for kids. The third-floor tower room is a private hideaway with twin beds and charming elevated views—perfect for teens or guests seeking a quiet retreat. Outside, guests can gather by the outdoor fireplace, enjoy alfresco dining with the propane grill, or explore the scenic surroundings by bike or electric cart. With six adult bikes and a 6-passenger electric cart included, exploring Camp WaterColor, Seaside, and the Beach Club is effortless and fun.Sleeping Arrangements First Floor Guest Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combination Common Area: Murphy Bed (Sleeps 2) Laundry Room Second Floor Primary Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Soaking Tub and Walk-In Shower Guest Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combination Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (Sleeps 2), Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combination Bunk Nook: One Set of Twin Bunk Beds (Sleeps 2), Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combination Third Floor Guest Bedroom: Two Twin Beds (Sleeps 2) Life in WaterColor Located just steps from Camp WaterColor, this home places guests in the heart of one of 30A’s most family-friendly neighborhoods. Enjoy exclusive access to the WaterColor Beach Club and community pools, explore the area’s scenic trails and lakes, or take a quick ride to Seaside for dining and shopping. With a perfect balance of comfort and convenience, 194 Spartina Circle offers the ultimate WaterColor experience.
